completeness_method: All 100 question objects and all 100 answer-key objects were read, including top-level metadata. Every line of all three supplied texts was emitted in separate bounded ranges using Python splitlines, including main line 1205 with no terminal newline. No tool output was truncated. Whole supplied p5 image visually checked to recover icon-only conversions. Coverage credit was assigned to actual requested question parts; incidental expected-answer material was not used to establish new coverage.
independence_statement: This is a newly assigned independent source challenger. I read only the assigned final question bank, final answer key, the three assigned authoritative source texts and the supplied unannotated p5 image. I did not read any summary, reader answer/grade, earlier report/conclusion, repair history or other task artifact. I did not contact any reader. I did not assume completeness. Novelty was checked independently against every actual question in the complete final bank. Only this requested JSON artifact was created.
